target_customer: Developers and teams building AI agents and products needing search over documents
problem: Semantic search normally needs embeddings, servers and ingestion pipelines.
business_model: Usage based, pay per query plus storage

founders.name: Dale Ng
founders.background_notes: Per YC page; co-founded Master Technologies at 17 and scaled his own company to 5,000 plus customers per YC page.

competitors.name: Seltz
competitors.what: Web search infrastructure for AI agents (adjacent, web not private data)

technical_complexity.rationale: Retrieval without embeddings that stays accurate is nontrivial.

defensibility.rationale: Retrieval quality is hard to prove but also copyable by vector database vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Many vendors offer retrieval; no takeover found.

market_need_then: Agent builders need retrieval; competitors raised seeds in 2026.

identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat, playful: Search so good it feels like magic

brand_strength.rationale: Memorable tagline but very close to WonderTx, Wondering and other Wonder names.

outcome_analysis: Wondersearch is a Fall 2026 search API from a two person team and parent Evokoa, which also builds a database product. No funding or exit is public. It competes in a crowded retrieval market where distribution will matter.
notes: No funding found. Parent company Evokoa founded 2025 per a directory listing. Competitors are adjacent, not exact. Founded year not stated for Wondersearch itself.
